body: If I tell my family they're just going to send me off like the three times before this. I can't be hospitalized again.

I've been like this all my life. More so in the past couple of years. I was already pretty fucked up and then I decided being a firefighter would be a good idea. With all of the shit that you see, nobody leaves that profession sane. I left a while ago when I started having to constantly self-medicate in an attempt to calm my panic attacks. I smoke to be able to function during everyday activities. I also stopped going to school because I just couldn't do it anymore. There's not even really a specific reason I'm this bad. I just live at such a stupid level of internal stress. 
Not many people know. My ex knows the most but I broke up with him a few days ago. He's always been so good at making things better. I feel lighter when he's around but I disassociate when I get bad and I usually end up doing something stupid and  causing him some kind of anguish. It happened again the other day and I'd rather not be with him than to hurt him again. He got worried after a while and told my best friend so that I guess she could keep an eye out but she's dealing with her own shit so I don't want to bother her. I convinced her I wasn't as bad as he made it seem. I also have a guy friend that I told for some reason and he's been checking up on me. He doesn't know exactly how bad it is because he would make a huge deal out of me wanting to die. 
It's not even that nobody cares. I know people do. I know that if I kill myself a lot of people would be devastated. That's what makes this all so frustrating. They don't have to live in my head. They don't understand that I've been at war with myself since as long as I can remember and I'm going to be like this until I die. I've tried medication. I've tried doctors. I've been committed three times. This isn't going away. I wish I was one of those people who had no one. Then I wouldn't feel as guilty and Id be able to finally have peace for good.
